blocks.text: SLEEK SOCKET ORIGINAL AND PATENTED FLAT ULTRA-THIN OUTLET CONCEALER WITH EXTENSION

items: 𝗜𝗱𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗞𝗶𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝗖𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗼𝗽𝘀 -- Now you can discreetly and completely hide the entire outlet with our outlet and cord concealer kit, while also enhancing your home décor! The flat extension cord provides a sleek solution for managing plugs and cables, creating a clutter-free environment. The dual 3-foot extension cord is perfect for powering appliances up to 3 feet in opposite directions of a single wall outlet. Ideal for kitchen countertops, providing power to appliances on opposite sides of a wall outlet.

𝗘𝗹𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝘂𝗴𝗹𝘆, 𝘂𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗳𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗹𝗸𝘆 𝗽𝗹𝘂𝗴𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗱𝘀 -- Less is MORE. Less clutter, less hazards, and less obstacles. This ultra-thin, wall-hugging device blends with the wall – you’ll forget it’s there! Perfect for any room, this sleek device enhances the visual appeal of your home while providing a practical solution to manage your outlets.

𝗡𝗼 𝘁𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀 𝗿𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱! -- Simply attach to the top receptacle of a duplex outlet like a traditional plug. This user-friendly design allows for quick and easy attachment without the need for any tools. Perfect for anyone looking to simplify their home setup without undergoing a DIY project.

𝗜𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗲𝘀 𝗔𝗱𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗱 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗿 𝗞𝗶𝘁 -- Consisting of double sided, removable adhesive strips and adhesive cord clips to neatly secure the cord to the wall. You deserve a simple solution that is cost effective and keeps your cords neatly organized and out of sight!

𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 -- Works with all standard duplex outlet sizes featuring a round ground pin below the flat pins (see attached thumbnail). This ensures a versatile fit for various outlets, making it easy to use with different setups. Whether you're organizing cords in your kitchen or discreetly concealing outlets, Sleek Socket offers a reliable fit for various setups while keeping your space neat and efficient.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
Compatible Devices
items.value: Any device that requires a standard North American 3-prong outlet
